confirm.title: Tilt Local Bridge
confirm.description: Set up {name}? Home Assistant will talk to it directly over Bluetooth, so the shades keep answering when Wi-Fi is down.

pair.title: Approve Home Assistant on {name}
pair.description:
The bridge is waiting for a button press it chose at random.

Tap **{direction}** on **{shade}** and let it move, then press Submit. The bridge checks every fifteen seconds; any other shade or direction cancels the request.

If the bridge's own Home Assistant entities are still reachable, the Approve phone pairing button accepts code **{code}** instead. The request expires after two minutes; Submit asks again.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer recognises this Home Assistant. Pair again with a shade button press.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge over Bluetooth. Move closer or check the bridge is advertising.
error.still_pending: Not approved yet. Press the button the bridge asked for, wait a moment, and submit again.
error.denied: That was not the press the bridge asked for. Follow the new instruction and try again.
error.expired: The request expired. A new one is waiting; follow the instruction and try again.
error.busy: Another device is waiting for approval on this bridge. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No Tilt Local Bridge is advertising within Bluetooth range.
